code: print(multiRL::func_alpha) func_alpha <- function(     qvalue,     reward,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]      alpha     <-  get_param(params, "alpha")   alphaN    <-  get_param(params, "alphaN")   alphaP    <-  get_param(params, "alphaP")      if (     !(is.na(alpha)) && is.na(alphaN) && is.na(alphaP)   ) {     model <- "TD"   } else if (     is.na(alpha) && !(is.na(alphaN)) && !(is.na(alphaP))   ) {     model <- "RSTD"   } else {     stop("Unknown Model! Plase modify your learning rate function")   }    # TD   if (model == "TD") {     update <- qvalue + alpha   * (reward - qvalue)   # RSTD   } else if (model == "RSTD" && reward < qvalue) {     update <- qvalue + alphaN * (reward - qvalue)   } else if (model == "RSTD" && reward >= qvalue) {     update <- qvalue + alphaP * (reward - qvalue)   }    return(update) } print(binaryRL::func_tau) func_beta <- function(     qvalue,      explor,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]      beta      <-  get_param(params, "beta")   lapse     <-  get_param(params, "lapse")      n_options <- length(qvalue)   prob      <- rep(x = NA_real_, times = n_options)   index     <- which(!is.na(qvalue))   n_shown   <- length(index)      if (explor == 1) {     # Exploration     prob[index] <- 1 / n_shown   } else {     # Exploitation     exp_stable <- exp(beta * (qvalue - max(qvalue, na.rm = TRUE)))     prob <- exp_stable / sum(exp_stable, na.rm = TRUE)   }      # lapse   prob <- (1 - lapse * n_shown) * prob + lapse      return(prob) } print(binaryRL::func_gamma) func_gamma <- function(     reward,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]    gamma     <-  get_param(params, "gamma")    utility <- sign(reward) * (abs(reward) ^ gamma) } print(binaryRL::func_pi) func_delta <- function(     count,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]      delta     <-  get_param(params, "delta")    bias <- delta * sqrt(log(count + exp(1)) / (count + 1e-10))      return(bias) } print(binaryRL::func_epsilon) func_epsilon <- function(     rownum,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]      epsilon   <-  get_param(params, "epsilon")   threshold <-  get_param(params, "threshold")      if (is.na(epsilon) && threshold > 0) {     model <- "first"   } else if (!(is.na(epsilon)) && threshold == 0) {     model <- "decreasing"   } else if (!(is.na(epsilon)) && threshold == 1) {     model <- "greedy"   } else {     stop("Unknown Model! Plase modify your learning rate function")   }      set.seed(rownum)   # Epsilon-First:    if (rownum <= threshold) {     try <- 1   } else if (rownum > threshold && model == "first") {     try <- 0   # Epsilon-Greedy:   } else if (rownum > threshold && model == "greedy"){     try <- sample(       c(1, 0),       prob = c(epsilon, 1 - epsilon),       size = 1     )   # Epsilon-Decreasing:    } else if (rownum > threshold && model == "decreasing") {     try <- sample(       c(1, 0),       prob = c(         1 / (1 + epsilon * rownum),         epsilon * rownum / (1 + epsilon * rownum)       ),       size = 1     )   }      return(try) } print(binaryRL::func_zeta) func_zeta <- function(     value0,      values,     reward,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]      zeta       <-  get_param(params, "zeta")   bonus      <-  get_param(params, "bonus")      if (reward == 0) {     decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values)   } else if (reward < 0) {     decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values) + bonus   } else if (reward > 0) {     decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values) - bonus   }    return(decay) }

code: my_func_gamma <- function(     reward,     params,     ... ){   # `get_param` is an internal function and must be accessed using `:::`   lambda    <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "lambda")   gamma     <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "gamma")   gammaN    <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "gammaN")   gammaP    <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "gammaP")      if (     gamma != 1 && is.na(gammaN) && is.na(gammaP)   ) {     model <- "Utility"   } else if (     gamma == 1 && !(is.na(gammaN)) && !(is.na(gammaP))   ) {     model <- "Prospect"   } else {     stop("Unknown Model! Plase modify your utility function")   }      # Stevens's Power Law   if (model == "Utility") {     utility <- sign(reward) * (abs(reward) ^ gamma)   }   # Prospect Theory   else if (model == "Prospect" && reward < 0) {     utility <- lambda * sign(reward) * (abs(reward) ^ gammaN)   }   else if (model == "Prospect" && reward >= 0) {     utility <- sign(reward) * (abs(reward) ^ gammaP)   }      return(utility) } multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(   data = data[data[, "Subject"] == 1, ],   behrule = behrule,   colnames = colnames,   params = list(     free = list(       alpha = 0.5,       beta = 0.5,       lambda = 1.5,       gammaN = 0.7,       gammaP = 0.3     )   ),   priors = list(     alpha = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)},      beta = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)},     lambda = function(x) {stats::dnorm(x, mean = 2, sd = 0.3, log = TRUE)},     gammaN = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)},     gammaP = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}   ),   funcs = list(     # Other unmodified `funcs` will use the built-in functions.     util_func = my_func_gamma   ),   settings = list(name = "Prospect", policy = "on") )  multiRL.summary <- multiRL::summary(multiRL.model) ## Model Fit: ##   Accuracy: 58.33% ##   Log-Likelihood: -264.91 ##   Log-Prior Probability: -0.74 ##   Log-Posterior Probability: -265.64 ##   AIC: 539.81 ##   BIC: 559.24

text: prob_func function defined inverse temperature    parameter (\(\beta\)) lapse parameter. inverse temperature parameter governs randomness choice.    \(\beta\) approaches 0, agent choose different    actions completely random.    \(\beta\) increases, choice becomes dependent    expected value (\(Q_{t}\)), meaning actions higher expected values    proportionally higher probability chosen. Note: formula includes normalization (\(Q_{t}\)) values. $$    P_{t}() =    \frac{      \exp\left( \beta \cdot \left( Q_t() - \max_{j} Q_t(a_j) \right) \right)    }{      \sum_{=1}^{k} \exp\left(        \beta \cdot \left( Q_t(a_i) - \max_{j} Q_t(a_j) \right) \right      )    }  $$ function , incorporates constant lapse rate,    correction standard soft-max rule. designed prevent    probability action becoming exactly 0    (Wilson Collins, 2019 doi:10.7554/eLife.49547 ).    lapse parameter set 0.01, every action least 1%    probability executed. number available actions becomes    excessively large (e.g., greater 100), appropriate    set lapse parameter much smaller value. $$    P_{t}() = (1 - lapse \cdot N_{shown}) \cdot P_{t}() + lapse  $$

Specifically, action    executed fewer times receives larger exploration bias.    (Sutton Barto,    2018)    mechanism prompts exploration ensures agent execute    every action least . $$    \text{Bias} = \delta \cdot \sqrt{\frac{\log(N + e)}{N + 10^{-10}}}  $$

title: Core Functions — funcs
text: expl_func function defined parameter (\(\epsilon\))    constant threshold. function controls probability    agent engages exploration (.e., making random choice)    versus exploitation (.e., making value-based choice). \(\epsilon–first\): agent must choose randomly fixed number    initial trials. number trials exceeds threshold, agent    must exclusively choose based value. $$  P(x) =  \begin{cases}    \le \text{threshold}, & x=1  \\    > \text{threshold}, & x=0  \end{cases}  $$ \(\epsilon–greedy\): agent performs random choice probability    \(\epsilon\) makes value-based choice probability    \(1-\epsilon\). $$  P(x) =  \begin{cases}    \epsilon, & x=1  \\    1-\epsilon, & x=0  \end{cases}  $$ \(\epsilon–decreasing\): probability making random choice    gradually decreases number trials increases throughout    experiment. $$  P(x) =  \begin{cases}    \frac{1}{1+\epsilon \cdot }, & x=1  \\    \frac{\epsilon \cdot }{1+\epsilon \cdot }, & x=0  \end{cases}  $$

code: func_epsilon <- function(     rownum,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]    epsilon   <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "epsilon")   threshold <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "threshold")    # Determine the model currently in use based on which parameters are free.   if (is.na(epsilon) && threshold > 0) {     model <- "first"   } else if (!(is.na(epsilon)) && threshold == 0) {     model <- "decreasing"   } else if (!(is.na(epsilon)) && threshold == 1) {     model <- "greedy"   } else {     stop("Unknown Model! Plase modify your learning rate function")   }    set.seed(rownum)   # Epsilon-First:   if (rownum <= threshold) {     try <- 1   } else if (rownum > threshold && model == "first") {     try <- 0     # Epsilon-Greedy:   } else if (rownum > threshold && model == "greedy"){     try <- sample(       c(1, 0),       prob = c(epsilon, 1 - epsilon),       size = 1     )     # Epsilon-Decreasing:   } else if (rownum > threshold && model == "decreasing") {     try <- sample(       c(1, 0),       prob = c(         1 / (1 + epsilon * rownum),         epsilon * rownum / (1 + epsilon * rownum)       ),       size = 1     )   }    return(try) }

code: func_zeta <- function(     value0,     values,     reward,     params,     ... ){   # if you need extra information   # e.g.   # Trial <- idinfo["Trial"]   # Frame <- exinfo["Frame"]    zeta       <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "zeta")   bonus      <-  multiRL:::get_param(params, "bonus")    if (reward == 0) {     decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values)   } else if (reward < 0) {     decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values) + bonus   } else if (reward > 0) {     decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values) - bonus   }    return(decay) }
